question: Which description defines a scalar quantity?
urdu_translation: scalar quantity کی درست تعریف کون سی ہے؟
A: A quantity requiring direction only / ایسی quantity جسے صرف direction درکار ہو
B: A quantity having no unit / ایسی quantity جس کی unit نہ ہو
C: A quantity represented only by an arrow / ایسی quantity جو صرف arrow سے ظاہر ہو
D: A quantity described completely by magnitude only / ایسی quantity جو صرف magnitude سے مکمل بیان ہو
correct_answer: D | A quantity described completely by magnitude only / ایسی quantity جو صرف magnitude سے مکمل بیان ہو

question: Which description defines a vector quantity?
urdu_translation: vector quantity کی درست تعریف کون سی ہے؟
A: A quantity requiring magnitude only / ایسی quantity جس کے لیے صرف magnitude ضروری ہو
B: A quantity having direction but no magnitude / ایسی quantity جس کی direction ہو مگر magnitude نہ ہو
C: A quantity requiring magnitude and direction / ایسی quantity جس کے لیے magnitude اور direction دونوں ضروری ہوں
D: A quantity having no numerical value / ایسی quantity جس کی numerical value نہ ہو
correct_answer: C | A quantity requiring magnitude and direction / ایسی quantity جس کے لیے magnitude اور direction دونوں ضروری ہوں

question: In a graphical vector representation, what does the length of the line show?
urdu_translation: graphical vector representation میں line کی length کیا ظاہر کرتی ہے؟
A: Unit of the vector / vector کی unit
B: Origin of the vector / vector کا origin
C: Magnitude of the vector / vector کی magnitude
D: Type of motion / motion کی type
correct_answer: C | Magnitude of the vector / vector کی magnitude

question: Which rule is used for graphical addition of vectors in the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter میں vectors کی graphical addition کے لیے کون سا rule استعمال ہوتا ہے؟
C: Parallelogram of moments / parallelogram of moments

question: The resultant vector in the head-to-tail method is drawn from:
urdu_translation: head-to-tail method میں resultant vector کہاں سے کہاں تک draw کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Head of the first vector to tail of the last vector / first vector کے head سے last vector کی tail تک
B: Tail of the first vector to head of the last vector / first vector کی tail سے last vector کے head تک
C: Origin to tail of the first vector / origin سے first vector کی tail تک
D: Head of each vector to the origin / ہر vector کے head سے origin تک
correct_answer: B | Tail of the first vector to head of the last vector / first vector کی tail سے last vector کے head تک

question: A body is said to be at rest when it:
urdu_translation: body کو rest میں کب کہا جاتا ہے؟
A: Moves with constant speed / constant speed سے move کرے
B: Changes direction continuously / direction continuously change کرے
C: Has zero mass / zero mass رکھتی ہو
D: Does not change position relative to its surroundings / اپنے surroundings کے لحاظ سے position change نہ کرے
correct_answer: D | Does not change position relative to its surroundings / اپنے surroundings کے لحاظ سے position change نہ کرے

question: A body is said to be in motion when it:
urdu_translation: body کو motion میں کب کہا جاتا ہے؟
A: Has no reference point / reference point نہ رکھتی ہو
B: Remains fixed for all observers / تمام observers کے لیے fixed رہے
C: Has constant temperature / constant temperature رکھتی ہو
D: Continuously changes position relative to its surroundings / اپنے surroundings کے لحاظ سے position continuously change کرے
correct_answer: D | Continuously changes position relative to its surroundings / اپنے surroundings کے لحاظ سے position continuously change کرے

question: The state of rest or motion of a body is described as relative because it depends on:
urdu_translation: body کی rest یا motion کی state کو relative کیوں کہا جاتا ہے؟
A: The chosen observer or surroundings / chosen observer یا surroundings
B: Only the mass of the body / صرف body کی mass
C: Only the shape of the body / صرف body کی shape
D: The temperature of the body / body کا temperature
correct_answer: A | The chosen observer or surroundings / chosen observer یا surroundings

question: Which three major types of motion are listed in the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter میں motion کی کون سی three major types دی گئی ہیں؟
A: Linear, scalar and vector / linear، scalar اور vector
B: Uniform, force and energy / uniform، force اور energy
C: Random, pressure and torque / random، pressure اور torque
D: Translatory, rotatory and vibratory / translatory، rotatory اور vibratory
correct_answer: D | Translatory, rotatory and vibratory / translatory، rotatory اور vibratory

question: Distance is defined as:
urdu_translation: distance کی definition کیا ہے؟
A: Shortest path from final to initial position / final سے initial position تک shortest path
B: Total length of the path travelled / travel کیے گئے path کی total length
C: Rate of change of velocity / velocity کی rate of change
D: Distance travelled per unit time / distance travelled per unit time
correct_answer: B | Total length of the path travelled / travel کیے گئے path کی total length

question: Displacement is defined as:
urdu_translation: displacement کی definition کیا ہے؟
A: Total path length travelled / total path length travelled
B: Shortest directed distance from initial to final position / initial سے final position تک shortest directed distance
C: Product of speed and acceleration / speed اور acceleration کا product
D: Area under acceleration-time graph / acceleration-time graph کے نیچے area
correct_answer: B | Shortest directed distance from initial to final position / initial سے final position تک shortest directed distance

question: The numerical ratio of displacement to distance is:
urdu_translation: displacement اور distance کا numerical ratio کیا ہو سکتا ہے؟
A: Equal to or less than one / one کے equal یا less
B: Always greater than one / always one سے greater
C: Always equal to two / always two کے equal
correct_answer: A | Equal to or less than one / one کے equal یا less

B: Constant speed and constant direction / constant speed اور constant direction

question: A body moves with constant speed along a circular path. Why is its velocity non-uniform?
